title: Which branch of Venezuela's government will the first government–opposition talks after Nicolás Maduro's removal agree to overhaul?
background: Nicolás Maduro was removed from power in January 2026, and Delcy Rodríguez became acting president. Previous negotiations between Venezuela's government and opposition have not produced a lasting political settlement.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official announcements from the negotiating parties or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the branch of government that both sides agree to comprehensively overhaul during their first formal negotiating round following Maduro's January 2026 removal. The round must conclude by August 31, 2026. An announced agreement is sufficient; implementation is not required. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The common name of the governmental branch, rather than an individual institution or officeholder.
